### What leadership changes did TELA Bio (TELA) announce on August 3, 2026?
TELA Bio’s board ended **Antony Koblish’s** service as CEO and principal executive officer on **August 3, 2026**, when he also resigned from the board, and simultaneously appointed **Heather Getz** as CEO, principal executive officer and a Class II director.
